data.display_address: Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers, Emirates Towers, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai
data.long_description:
Set within one of Dubai’s most coveted addresses, Jumeirah Residences embody the elegance, heritage, and modern sophistication that define the Jumeirah name. Blending timeless architecture with contemporary design, these residences offer a rare balance of coastal tranquility and urban connectivity.


  Spacious interiors are framed by floor-to-ceiling windows, drawing in natural light and sweeping views of the Arabian Gulf, the city skyline, and the vibrant Jumeirah district. Each residence is meticulously crafted with refined finishes, intuitive layouts, and a seamless connection to the outdoors, creating homes that feel both private and expansive.


  Living at Jumeirah Residences grants access to an exclusive lifestyle shaped by five-star hospitality, from world-class dining and wellness retreats to personalized services that redefine everyday living. Just moments from pristine beaches, cultural landmarks, and Dubai’s most dynamic neighborhoods, this address is as practical as it is prestigious.


  Jumeirah Residences is not just a place to live, it is a legacy to belong to.
